properties.entry: WITH CUSTOMER_MONTH_BILL_DATA AS ( SELECT KCA.ID_CUSTOMER, SUM(CASE WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '15 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST / 2.0 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_SERVICE_COST FROM KYC_CUSTOMER_SERVICE KCS INNER JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_APPLICATION KCA ON KCS.FOLIO = KCA.ID WHERE KCS.ACTIVE = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM KYC_CUSTOMER_BILL_CONTROL KCBC WHERE KCBC.ID_CUSTOMER = KCA.ID_CUSTOMER AND KCBC.ID_STATUS IN (1, 2, 4) AND KCBC.ISSUE_DATE >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND KCBC.ISSUE_DATE < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) GROUP BY KCA.ID_CUSTOMER HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST WHEN KCS.CREATION_DATE < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '15 days' THEN KCS.SERVICE_COST / 2.0 ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ID_CUSTOMER) AS ID, ID_CUSTOMER, TOTAL_SERVICE_COST FROM CUSTOMER_MONTH_BILL_DATA

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS ID,KCA.ID_CUSTOMER,KCS.ID_SERVICE,KCBC.ID AS ID_BILL FROM KYC_CUSTOMER_SERVICE KCS INNER JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_APPLICATION KCA ON KCS.FOLIO = KCA.ID INNER JOIN KYC_CUSTOMER_BILL_CONTROL KCBC ON KCBC.ID_CUSTOMER = KCA.ID_CUSTOMER WHERE KCS.ACTIVE = TRUE AND KCBC.SETTLED = FALSE AND KCBC.ID_STATUS = 4 AND DATE(KCBC.ISSUE_DATE) = CURRENT_DATE
